title: Protected Correction Sync UI Handoff
principle: The public UI is a zero-trust handoff client: it previews metadata, checks protected backend capability and syncs only after an explicit user action.
public_repo_rule: The UI must never store backend API keys, provider secrets, raw prompts, raw responses, chat transcripts or document text in GitHub Pages.

ui_surfaces.purpose: Show correction metadata count, sync preview and actions after Memory correction trails.
Show correction metadata count, sync preview and actions after Knowledge correction trails.
Show protected backend contract evidence and current sync status in the Progress Dashboard.

actions.behavior: Calls protected /status on the active backend profile and requires context.corrections capability.
POSTs sanitized events to /context/corrections with raw_prompt_stored:false and raw_response_stored:false.
Marks correction trails as deferred and keeps them browser-local.
Opens backend settings without creating paid routes.
Opens identity/session tools so protected backend auth can be activated without storing tokens in localStorage.

scenarios.expected: Users see count and sample metadata before sync.
Check backend verifies /status and context.corrections before users trust sync availability.
Sync metadata posts sanitized events to /context/corrections through the shared API client.
Users can keep correction trails browser-local and sync later.
